card.name: Last digit of a number before mg
card.fires_on: The final digit of a number written in pieces, just before a unit such as mg, mg/dL or mEq/liter. It appears in dose amounts and lab thresholds like calcium or phosphate levels.

modes.label: Final digit of a dose
modes.description: A trailing 0 ending a dose amount such as 100 or 180 before mg.
modes.example: reduce dose by 10<<0>> mg and resume treatment, or by

modes.label: Final digit of a lab cutoff
modes.description: The last digit of a serum calcium or phosphate threshold before mg/dL.
modes.example: serum phosphorus below 5.<<5>> mg/dL. • Monitor serum calcium

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly odd byte pieces and the suppressed ones are unit fragments, so there is no clear output effect beyond this.
card.plain: It lights up on the last digit of a number just before a unit like mg or mg/dL.
